items.headline: [US Feature Stocks] Albemarle reaches tentative wage agreement with union day before Chilean strike
items.snippet: Albemarle (ALB) reached a tentative wage agreement with Chilean union leadership on the final day of negotiation talks ahead of a strike.

items.headline: Albemarle's Next CEO Inherits A $250 Million Swing Per Dollar
items.snippet: JPMorgan analyst Jeffrey Zekauskas recently cut Albemarle's 2026 adjusted EBITDA estimate by 14.4% to $2.88 billion. Chinese prices averaged about $21,625 a ton so far in the third quarter, down from $24,810 in the second.

items.headline: Market Chatter: Lithium Miners' Profits Surge as Battery Storage Demand Drives Prices Higher
items.snippet: US-headquartered Albemarle (ALB) noted that global lithium demand grew 45% through May this year, significantly outstripping supply.

items.headline: Albemarle's Lithium Math Turns Brutal
items.snippet: JPMorgan now expects lithium prices to remain in the low-$20-per-kilogram range. Albemarle faces delays at the Greenbushes CGP3 plant following a June fire; ALB shares were down 5.16% at $134.21.

items.headline: Albemarle to Benefit From Low-cost Assets, Brownfield Opportunity, RBC Says
items.snippet: RBC has an outperform rating on Albemarle and decreased the company's price target to $157 from $166.
